thread.title: Apple explores iHeartMedia stake - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Yoel Minkoff
title: Apple explores iHeartMedia stake - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is turning to traditional broadcasting to boost its streaming service, exploring a tie-up with iHeartMedia ( OTCPK:IHRTQ ), the largest U.S. radio group that is attempting to claw itself out of bankruptcy, FT reports .
iHeartMedia is hoping Apple will take an equity stake worth tens of millions of dollars, but others suggested the deal could result in a multimillion-dollar marketing partnership rather than a direct investment.
